answer.method_summary: Prospective adaptive rule for the declared higher-is-better Growth/OrganismalFitness endpoint: use item-bound, endpoint-aligned measured evidence if available; none was available here, so invoke the generic-plausibility fallback. Require a successful per-variant receipt for both signals, rank each signal higher-is-better across the frozen candidate set, and score 0.70×ESM-2 Δlog-probability percentile + 0.30×ESM-IF1 mean-log-likelihood percentile because ESM-2 is a mutation-local WT contrast while IF1 is a secondary backbone-conditioned plausibility check. Sort descending; ties break by ESM-2, then IF1, then mutant lexically. Select exactly the first ten. A failed signal is retried and never imputed as zero; unresolved failure is a coverage failure. These are generic sequence/backbone plausibility signals, not measured assay outcomes, and may be mechanistically misaligned with organismal growth.
